🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — October 30, 2026

Sun, in Scorpio, holds a trine to Moon, at home in Cancer. The same water temperament, twice over: what you hold gets named without shrinking in the telling.

Easier — Letting go of something you had kept out of habit.
Harder — Wide gestures, vague promises, starting on appetite alone.
Backdrop — Saturn and Uranus have just closed a sextile, new under everything else.

♈ ARIES
Mars rules you from Leo, untitled. Moon in Cancer presses on you, and the pressure is arithmetic. Cardinal fire: the beginning has a price on it. The trine to Saturn that held a week ago has let go.

♉ TAURUS
Venus, your ruler, is at home in Libra. From Cancer, Moon makes something possible and nothing certain. Fixed earth: nothing needs letting go of today. Venus has been out of Scorpio for four weeks now.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury, your ruler, crosses Scorpio untitled. Venus in Libra trines you: agreement arrives before the argument. Air that changes shape, and the shape fits. The hold Moon had a week ago is not there any more.

♋ CANCER
Moon governs you, at home in Cancer. Sun trines you from Scorpio, meeting no resistance. Cardinal water: the opening move is the cheap one. A week ago Moon was still held by Mercury; that is finished.

♌ LEO
Sun governs you, untitled in Scorpio. Mercury squares you from Scorpio, and the cost objects. Fixed fire: the grip costs more than the thing. Since Sun crossed out of Libra, the question has changed.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury, your ruler, is only passing through Scorpio. Sun in Scorpio opens a gap you have to step into. Mutable earth: two answers, neither expensive. Mercury turned back a week ago; the review is still running.

♎ LIBRA
Venus rules you from its own Libra. From Cancer, Moon sets a figure against the wanting. Cardinal air starts and is invoiced for it. Sun let go of it a week ago.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars, your ruler, crosses Leo untitled. Sun is inside your sign, at arm’s length. Water holds until owning and being coincide. Mars is 15° further on than in early October, which is barely further on.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter, your ruler, moves through Leo unannounced. Venus sextiles you from Libra: a door left ajar. Fire bends, and bending costs nothing here. Four weeks in, and the shape of it is no longer a surprise.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn governs you from Aries, where it stands lowest. Sun sextiles you from Scorpio: help that waits to be asked for. Cardinal earth: beginning costs almost nothing. What pressed a week ago has cleared.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn, your ruler, has no support in Aries and asks twice for half. From Scorpio, Sun cuts across the appetite. Air that holds on, charged for holding. Nothing about it is a week old.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter governs you, untitled in Leo. Sun trines you from Scorpio, and the ease asks its own attention. Mutable water: two answers, and both are affordable. The sextile of two weeks ago is off it now.
